**`cargo-dist-schema/src/lib.rs`** — the `DistManifest` struct:

**`cargo-dist/src/tasks.rs`** — `DistGraphBuilder::new`:
- Added the boolean parameter `announcement_tag_is_implicit` right after `allow_all_dirty`.
